content.text: preferred over NDHP when used in combo w/ BB
worsening angina or MI d/t reflexive tachy
: sinus brady, AV nodal block, hypotension, HF, ↑ LFTs
Classes: dihydropyridines (the -pines: amlodipine, felodipine, nicardipine, isradipine, nifedipine); benzothiazepines (diltiazem); phenylalkylamines (verapamil)
Intracell Ca ↑ in ischemia -> ↑ enzymes that worsen ischemia
Also SE: drowsiness, weakness, postural hypotension
Bind L-type Ca voltage channel -> block -> ↓ Ca into cell -> ↓ contractility
In ♡, coronary, periph vasc -> smooth musc relax
Slight diuretic effect: Intrinsic naturietic  effect -> ⍉ need diuretic
MOA: Inhibit CYP3A4 enzyme -> ↓ hepatic clearing of CYP3A4 meds
More than DHP: ↓ ♡ O2 demand & ♡ work-load -> (-)ionotropic
Least selective CCB -> ↑ effect on ♡ & vasc smooth musc
More selective for vasc smooth musc than ♡
↓ DI than NDHP (esp w digoxin, warfarin)
Dose related LE edema -> more in AFAB
: ↓ venous return (↓ preload) which ↓ LV wall tension
: ↑ blood flow thru collateral arteries (⍉atherosclerotic arteries)
recommended for all pts w/ angina for immediate relief
MOA:organic nitrates ->NO ->activates guanylate cyclase enzyme (form cGMP) ->dephosphorylate myosin light chain (smooth musc) ->relax-vasodilate
↑room in vessel for O2 to pass -> rapid ↓♡O2 demand ->rapid ↓Sx
Education: Tolerance develops rapidly -> need nitrate-free interval daily (prn ⍉ as effective)
MOA: ↓oral bioavailabilty (extensive 1st pass met via liver)
Acute angina: SL (fast act, short ½ life), can be preventative: 14Hr drug-free interval daily
ERL 18hr drug-free interval daily -pt ⍉take @same time every day
MOA: ↑bioavail - metabolite of isosorbide dinitrate so ⍉1st pass
ER (longest ½ life): QD for 12hr drug-free interval
Norm: 7hr apart dosing for 12 hr nitrate-free interval
Acute: SL or spray (fast, short ½ life): 1 tab Q5min up to 3x
transdermal (longer ½ life): QD for 12Hr drug-free interval
Spray under tongue->close mouth->⍉ SWALLOW. ⍉ SPIT/RINSE FOR 5-15 MIN, ⍉ INHALE
